tools.name: startup_preview
tools.description: Free preview of dated business evidence and launch signals. Explains membership access, limits and caveats; no key needed.

tools.name: search_startup_cases
tools.description: MEMBER: find source-backed AI startup cases, with dated revenue/adoption/failure evidence. Default excludes company references. Relevance is not success probability.

tools.name: compare_startup_cases
tools.description: MEMBER: compare 2–4 reviewed cases for the same customer job. Retains metric periods, team evidence and limits; never converts revenue to profit.

tools.name: get_startup_radar
tools.description: MEMBER: query daily Show HN discussion samples and Product Hunt launches, with dates and optional retained history. Launches and keywords are unreviewed; no revenue or solo verdict.

tools.name: build_startup_plan
tools.description: MEMBER: build a source-linked 14-day validation plan, opposing success/failure evidence, unit economics and website-upgrade suggestions. Local retrieval and neural representation, no external LLM. Do not send customer secrets.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_startup_radar" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "build_startup_plan" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
